record.summary: Apart from the accepted deviations, the render matches the frame. The only remaining difference is that the gap between each card's name and its purpose text is about 2 px smaller.

findings.reference_location: each card, between the name line (y about 307) and the first purpose line (y about 336)
findings.reference_shows: about 29 px from the name's baseline area to the first purpose line, e.g. "Pinpoint" over "A Chrome extension that pins comments on"
findings.render_location: each card, between the name line (y about 223) and the first purpose line (y about 250)
findings.render_shows: about 27 px between the name line and the first purpose line, the same in all three cards

accepted_deviations.as_given: New project shows as the frame draws it and does nothing: making a project is increment four (d-133, f-008 increment one, Out of scope).
accepted_deviations.note: The button shows at top right as in the frame. Its 4 px shift to the left is part of A11.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Edit details shows in each card's menu and does nothing: editing a project's details is increment four (d-133).
accepted_deviations.note: The open menu on the Pinpoint card shows "Pin to top" and "Edit details" in the frame's position.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Pin icon. The library has no pin icon, so a pinned card shows the 16 px pill "Pinned" after its name, which keeps the name's line height.
accepted_deviations.note: NCC-1701 shows a "Pinned" pill where the frame has a pin glyph. The name line sits level with the other cards.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Tile. The letter tile is shorter than the frame's and its letter is the heading style, smaller than the frame's; no token has the frame's height or letter size.
accepted_deviations.note: The tile is about 120 px tall, where the frame's is about 204 px. Because of this the cards end at y about 337, where the frame's end at about 401.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Purpose. The purpose is a bodySm paragraph in the card's meta row, as the library's Card description shows only one or two lines.

Purpose wraps. The purpose is bodySm (13/20), whose glyphs are about 4 % narrower than the frame's; Pinpoint's and omni's lines break at other words and NCC-1701's purpose takes four lines where the frame's takes three. The line height (20 px) is the frame's.
accepted_deviations.note: The line breaks are the ones described. Because NCC-1701's purpose takes four lines, the Pinpoint and omni cards have one empty line of space at the bottom.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Unpin. A pinned card's menu says Unpin in place of Pin to top. No frame draws a pinned card's menu.
accepted_deviations.note: Only Pinpoint's menu is open, and Pinpoint is not pinned.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Owner's name. NCC-1701's purpose starts "The owner's personal workspace" in the state file, where the frame has the owner's name.
Cards heading. A heading "All projects" that only a screen reader reads sits between the page title and the cards. No frame draws it.
accepted_deviations.note: The heading is not visible, as expected for text that only a screen reader reads.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Rail. The rail is the app's shared one in the default order: Inbox, Workspaces, Projects, Artifacts, Toolkit and More. The frame draws an older rail with Inbox, Workspaces, Projects and More.

Sides. The page is 40 in from the rail and the window's edge, so each of the four columns is the frame's 327 px; the frame has 36, so the header and the cards start 4 px further right than the frame's.
accepted_deviations.note: The title and the first card start about 4 px further right, and New project ends about 4 px further left.

limits: The starfield background was not compared star by star.
Card widths and gaps were measured by eye only. Differences of 1 to 2 px in the cards' edges were not confirmed.
